summary: A young man tubing Boulder Creek became stranded on a rock in the middle of the creek at Eben Fine Park during high spring runoff; a companion hiked to the park for help and 911 was called around 7:30 p.m.
location: Boulder Creek at Eben Fine Park
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder Fire-Rescue; Boulder Emergency Services; Sunshine Fire Protection District; Four Mile Fire Protection District; American Medical Response
notes: Date pinned: 'Saturday evening' + June 14, 2018 print edition -> 2018-06-09 Saturday. Technical whitewater raft-and-line rescue; the man was wet, cold and banged up but otherwise safe; rescue complete ~8:30 p.m.
